privacy: Neutral invented messages, devices and receipts only; no tokens, push endpoints, chat IDs or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner
title: Owner: a reminder read in the app does not reach Telegram
goal: The owner opens a pushed reminder in the app without tapping the notification and Telegram stays silent
acceptance: On NERV-01 after the fix: a reminder due in a minute arrives as a push; the owner does not tap it but opens the app and sees it; 12 minutes after it was due Telegram has not sent it
validation: Owner device check, recorded in B-149 Verification

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: one reminder and a 12-minute wait, in the same phone sitting as F-004-T10. Not a measurement.
